htn_kidney.title: Deep learning-driven immunohistochemical analysis of renal lymphatics for chronic kidney disease: bioinformatic and histopathological study.
htn_kidney.journal: Journal of pathology and translational medicine
htn_kidney.authors: Xu X, Lin Y, Pei G
htn_kidney.zhSummary: 该文聚焦高血压肾病，属于临床研究。核心观点：肾淋巴管密度与肾脏疾病具有临床相关性，但仍通过缓慢、主观的视觉估计来评估。 临床提示：我们评估了一个弱监督、基于注意力的多实例学习框架，用于在 D2-40 染色的全玻片图像 (WSI) 上自动检测和量化肾淋巴管密度。
htn_kidney.abstract: Renal lymphatic vessel density is clinically relevant in kidney disease but is still assessed by slow, subjective visual estimation. We evaluated a weakly supervised, attention-based multiple-instance learning framework for automated detection and quantification of renal lymphatic vessel density on D2-40-stained whole-slide images (WSIs). Two independent internal datasets from Tongji Hospital were collected, including 198 cases of chronic kidney disease (CKD) and 50 cases of hypertensive nephropathy (HTN). All biopsies were immunohistochemically stained for D2-40 and digitized as WSIs. Pathologists provided only slide-level labels (D2-40 high vs. D2-40 low). Tissue regions were automatically...

portal_hypertension.title: DOACs reduce risk for new-onset portal hypertension in patients with cirrhosis and atrial fibrillation: A retrospective cohort study.
portal_hypertension.authors: Su Y, Wang J, Dong Q
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：由于血栓形成和出血风险相互矛盾，肝硬化和心房颤动 (AF) 患者面临着治疗挑战。 临床提示：直接口服抗凝剂（DOAC）在这一人群中的作用仍不确定。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Patients with liver cirrhosis and atrial fibrillation (AF) pose a therapeutic challenge due to the conflicting risks of thrombosis and bleeding. The role of direct oral anticoagulants (DOACs) in this population remains uncertain. This study aims to evaluate the impact of anticoagulation therapy on new-onset portal hypertension and related complications in cirrhotic patients with AF. A retrospective cohort study was conducted in 502 hospitalized patients with cirrhosis and AF at Beijing Ditan Hospital (2010-2019). Clinical data, risk scores, and liver severity indices (Child-Pugh, Model for End-Stage Liver Disease) were collected. Propensity score matching was applied to minimize confounding....

portal_hypertension.title: A nurse practitioner's guide to metabolic dysfunction‑associated steatotic liver disease: From diagnosis to management.
portal_hypertension.journal: Journal of the American Association of Nurse Practitioners
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：代谢功能障碍相关的脂肪肝病 (MASLD) 是全世界最常见的慢性肝病，过去三十年患病率增加了 50%。 临床提示：MASLD 曾经被认为是“无辜的旁观者”，现在被理解为一种与肥胖、2 型糖尿病、血脂异常和心血管疾病相关的多系统疾病。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Metabolic dysfunction‑associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) is the most common chronic liver disease worldwide, as demonstrated by a 50% increase in the prevalence over the past three decades. More than one quarter of the global population and nearly 40% of adults in the United States are affected by this burdensome disease. Once thought to be an "innocent bystander," MASLD is now understood as a multisystem disease associated with obesity, type 2 diabetes mellitus, dyslipidemia, and cardiovascular disease. Its rising prevalence emphasizes the critical role of primary care providers, including nurse practitioners (NP), in early identification and management. Existing on a spectrum, MASL...

portal_hypertension.title: Non-cirrhotic Portal Fibrosis, Idiopathic Portal Hypertension and Porto-sinusoidal Vascular Diseases: From Debates to Future Directions.
portal_hypertension.authors: Sarin SK, Tripathti DM, Lohse AW
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：PubMed 没有可用的摘要。 临床提示：非肝硬化门静脉纤维化、特发性门静脉高压和门窦血管疾病：从争论到未来方向。
